{{Quote|Now we vanquish ''any'' who still hold his ways&hellip; who will not serve the ''Imperial'' cause! As the ''Empire'' rules the galaxy&mdash;''Droid World is ours to command!''<nowiki></nowiki>|[[Z-X3|Zee-Exthree]]|<ref name="SW47" />}}
A '''civil war''' took place aboard [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]] shortly after the [[Battle of Xeron]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] between [[Kligson/Legends|Kligson's]] [[Kligson's faction|faction]] and [[Z-X3|Zee-Exthree's]] [[Z-X3's faction|faction]].
